description: This file implements an Azure-specific OpenAI language model service within the Pipecat AI framework. It defines a class 'AzureLLMService' that extends 'OpenAILLMService' to integrate with Azure's OpenAI API using the 'AsyncAzureOpenAI' client, providing methods for initialization and client creation.

classes.name: AzureLLMService
classes.description: A service for interacting with Azure OpenAI using the OpenAI-compatible interface, extending the 'OpenAILLMService' class.

methods.description: Creates and returns an AsyncAzureOpenAI client configured for Azure's OpenAI API endpoint.
